site.title: IGdm - Instagram Desktop Messenger

site.domainNote: IGdm — unofficial Instagram desktop DM client; capture shows a full-screen 'following' overlay with Unfollow actions

view.name: Users not following back
view.description: Full-screen overlay listing accounts that don't follow the user back as a grid of avatars with usernames and Unfollow buttons, with a close icon.

regions.label: Full-screen white overlay with close X top-right, listing 26 followed accounts in a 4-column grid, each with avatar, username and blue Unfollow button

evidence.note: Opaque white full-screen layer covering the chat app (search, conversation list, composer present in ARIA but hidden); Escape on live page closes it to reveal the inbox

novel.description: Manage-list dialog: a roster of followed accounts with a per-item destructive action (Unfollow), not a single selection or form

evidence.note: Borderless user tile: circular avatar, username, single Unfollow button; repeated 26 times in a 4-column grid
Conversation list with timestamps/snippets exists in DOM/ARIA but is fully covered by the overlay in the capture

patterns.rationale: The inbox list exists underneath but is not visible in the capture; coded absent because the label describes the visible capture.

evidence.note: Message composer exists in DOM but hidden behind overlay; no thread open

structure.layout: full-screen overlay with a centered 4-column grid of user tiles (avatar, username, Unfollow button) and a close X top-right; the chat app beneath is fully hidden

aesthetics.typography: System UI stack (-apple-system / Helvetica-like) throughout: usernames 16px regular dark, button labels 16px white
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat: almost everything 16px/400; 14px in hidden chat list; no headings on the overlay

notes: Bootstrap-flavored (text #212529, 4px-radius primary buttons in Instagram-ish blue #168bf9). Avatars are 48px circles: either flat illustrated people or colored monogram discs with serif initials and an inner ring. Tiles sit on pure white with no containers, ~150px vertical pitch, each column 360px wide. No title on the overlay; only a thin grey X close at top right. Last row (2 items) is centered.
